# What this notebook does

Kate, 2026-10-28: linear models of **log2 TE change, sictrl vs si3d** (`te_lfc` =
log2(sictrl / si3d), positive = eIF3d promotes) on three predictors only: **GC3**
(`gc3_internal`, %), **log2 CDS length** and **log2 5'UTR length** (log2(nt + 1)). Same model
set as `37_utr_cds_length_models.Rmd`, with GC3 in place of 3'UTR length: each predictor alone,
each pair additive, all three additive, all three multiplicative (all interactions).

Run once per TE contrast with `39_render_contrasts.R`:

- **hypoxia 1hr**: `output/translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv`
- **normoxia 1+4hr, time-regressed**: `output/translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_normoxia_1and4hr.csv`,
  from `code/eif3e_eif3d_normoxia_and_hypoxia.Rmd` (`deFunction_time_normalized`, normoxia,
  `hours %in% c(1, 4)` as a factor covariate, control = si3d, test = sictrl).

This run: **`r params$label`**, TE from `output/`r params$de_file``.

Genes: the modelled gene set (the SHAP explain set, 10,172), so the two contrasts are fitted on
the same genes and only the outcome differs. Predictors are **z-scored** (mean 0, sd 1) so the
three coefficients are on one scale (change in log2 TE change per SD) and main effects in the
multiplicative model are slopes at an average gene. R² does not depend on the scaling.

```{r libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(here); library(patchwork) })
O <- here("output", "translational_control_overview")
SAVE <- isTRUE(params$save_plots)
```

# 1. Data and checks

```{r data}
de <- read_csv(here("output", params$de_file), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("[.].*", "", gene_id))
kd <- de$rna_lfc[de$symbol == "EIF3D"]
stopifnot("EIF3D not found once" = length(kd) == 1,
          "EIF3D rna_lfc not strongly positive: direction flipped or wrong knockdown" = kd > 1,
          "duplicate genes in the DE file" = !anyDuplicated(de$gene_id_clean))
cat(sprintf("TE source: output/%s\nEIF3D rna_lfc %+.2f -> log2(sictrl / si3d) confirmed\n", params$de_file, kd))

genes <- readRDS(file.path(O, paste0("shap_oof_", params$suffix, ".rds")))$genes$gene_id_clean
fm <- readRDS(file.path(O, params$matrix_rds))
stopifnot("matrix has duplicate genes" = !anyDuplicated(fm$gene_id_clean),
          "modelled genes missing from the DE file" = all(genes %in% de$gene_id_clean))
num <- function(col) as.numeric(unlist(fm[[col]][match(genes, fm$gene_id_clean)]))
d <- tibble(gene_id_clean = genes, te_lfc = de$te_lfc[match(genes, de$gene_id_clean)],
            gc3 = num("gc3_internal"), cds = num("log2_cds_length"), utr5 = num("log2_utr5_length")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(te_lfc), !is.na(gc3), !is.na(cds), !is.na(utr5)) %>% arrange(gene_id_clean)   # fixed order for CV folds
stopifnot("log fold changes not finite" = all(is.finite(d$te_lfc)),
          "GC3 outside [0, 100]" = all(d$gc3 >= 0 & d$gc3 <= 100),
          "GC3 median outside 40-65%" = between(median(d$gc3), 40, 65),
          "lengths out of range" = all(d$cds > 0) && all(d$utr5 >= 0))
sds <- sapply(d[, c("gc3", "cds", "utr5")], sd)
cat(sprintf("genes %s of %s modelled; median te_lfc %.3f\nSD used for scaling: GC3 %.1f points, log2 CDS length %.2f, log2 5'UTR length %.2f\n",
            scales::comma(nrow(d)), scales::comma(length(genes)), median(d$te_lfc), sds["gc3"], sds["cds"], sds["utr5"]))
knitr::kable(round(cor(d[, c("gc3", "cds", "utr5")], method = "spearman"), 3), caption = "Spearman rho between the predictors")
```

# 2. The models

```{r fit}
dz <- d %>% mutate(across(c(gc3, cds, utr5), ~ (.x - mean(.x)) / sd(.x)))
forms <- c("GC3 alone" = "gc3", "CDS alone" = "cds", "5'UTR alone" = "utr5",
           "GC3 + CDS" = "gc3 + cds", "GC3 + 5'UTR" = "gc3 + utr5", "CDS + 5'UTR" = "cds + utr5",
           "GC3 + CDS + 5'UTR" = "gc3 + cds + utr5",
           "GC3 x CDS x 5'UTR" = "gc3 * cds * utr5")
set.seed(9); fold <- sample(rep(1:10, length.out = nrow(dz)))
fit_one <- function(rhs) {
  f <- as.formula(paste("te_lfc ~", rhs)); m <- lm(f, data = dz)
  cv <- numeric(nrow(dz))
  for (k in 1:10) cv[fold == k] <- predict(lm(f, data = dz[fold != k, ]), dz[fold == k, ])
  list(m = m, row = tibble(n_terms = length(coef(m)) - 1, adj_r2 = summary(m)$adj.r.squared,
                           cv_r2 = 1 - sum((dz$te_lfc - cv)^2) / sum((dz$te_lfc - mean(dz$te_lfc))^2)))
}
fits <- map(forms, fit_one)
tab <- imap_dfr(fits, ~ .x$row %>% mutate(model = .y, .before = 1))
stopifnot("single-predictor R2 must equal r^2" =
            abs(summary(fits[["GC3 alone"]]$m)$r.squared - cor(dz$gc3, dz$te_lfc)^2) < 1e-10)
knitr::kable(tab, digits = c(0, 0, 4, 4),
             caption = sprintf("%s: log2 TE change (sictrl vs si3d), n = %s genes", params$label, scales::comma(nrow(dz))))
```

## Does each predictor add to the other two? (nested F tests)

```{r nested}
nest <- tribble(~smaller, ~larger, ~adds,
  "CDS + 5'UTR", "GC3 + CDS + 5'UTR", "GC3",
  "GC3 + 5'UTR", "GC3 + CDS + 5'UTR", "CDS",
  "GC3 + CDS", "GC3 + CDS + 5'UTR", "5'UTR",
  "GC3 + CDS + 5'UTR", "GC3 x CDS x 5'UTR", "the four interaction terms") %>%
  mutate(adj_r2_gain = map2_dbl(smaller, larger, ~ tab$adj_r2[tab$model == .y] - tab$adj_r2[tab$model == .x]),
         cv_r2_gain = map2_dbl(smaller, larger, ~ tab$cv_r2[tab$model == .y] - tab$cv_r2[tab$model == .x]),
         F_p = map2_dbl(smaller, larger, ~ anova(fits[[.x]]$m, fits[[.y]]$m)$`Pr(>F)`[2]))
knitr::kable(nest, digits = c(0, 0, 0, 4, 4, 300))
```

## Coefficients

Change in log2 TE change (sictrl vs si3d) per SD of each predictor, 95% CI.

```{r coefs}
term_lab <- c(gc3 = "GC3", cds = "CDS", utr5 = "5'UTR")
coefs <- imap_dfr(fits, function(f, nm) {
  s <- summary(f$m)$coefficients; ci <- confint(f$m)
  tibble(model = nm, term = rownames(s), estimate = s[, 1], lo = ci[, 1], hi = ci[, 2], p = s[, 4])
}) %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, c(gc3 = "GC3", cds = "CDS", utr5 = "5'UTR", ":" = " x ")))
knitr::kable(coefs %>% filter(model %in% c("GC3 + CDS + 5'UTR", "GC3 x CDS x 5'UTR")), digits = c(0, 0, 4, 4, 4, 300))
if (SAVE) {
  write_csv(tab, file.path(O, sprintf("gc3_length_models_fit_%s.csv", params$tag)))
  write_csv(coefs, file.path(O, sprintf("gc3_length_models_coefficients_%s.csv", params$tag)))
}
```

## Figure: fit and coefficients

```{r fig_models, fig.width = 13, fig.height = 5.5}
tl <- tab %>% mutate(model = factor(model, levels = rev(names(forms))))
p_r2 <- ggplot(tl, aes(y = model)) +
  geom_col(aes(x = adj_r2), fill = "grey75", width = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(x = cv_r2), colour = "black", size = 2) +
  labs(x = "adjusted R² (bar); 10-fold CV R² (point)", y = NULL, title = "fit: log2 TE change, sictrl vs si3d") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
betas <- coefs %>% filter(term %in% term_lab) %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = term_lab), model = factor(model, levels = levels(tl$model)))
p_beta <- ggplot(betas, aes(estimate, model, colour = term)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), position = position_dodge(width = 0.6), size = 0.3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(GC3 = "#CC79A7", CDS = "#0072B2", `5'UTR` = "#009E73"), name = NULL) +
  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "coefficient: change in log2 TE change per SD (95% CI)", y = NULL, title = "linear coefficients") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank())
p_mod <- p_r2 + p_beta + plot_annotation(
  title = sprintf("%s: TE change (sictrl vs si3d) explained by GC3, CDS length and 5'UTR length", params$label),
  subtitle = sprintf("TE from %s; GC3, log2 CDS length, log2 5'UTR length, z-scored; n = %s genes",
                     params$te_word, scales::comma(nrow(dz))))
p_mod
if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", sprintf("39_gc3_length_models_fit_%s.pdf", params$tag)), p_mod, width = 13, height = 5.5)
```
